declaredParameters.rule: Union every ring of every part in the declared CRS, then measure the result. Ground covered twice is counted once.
declaredParameters.partsAreaRule: Sum of each part net of its holes, so a hole-bearing part does not read as overlapping itself.
declaredParameters.semantics: The combined area is how much distinct ground the parts cover. It is not the sum of the parts, and the difference is the overlap.
declaredParameters.method: Union of 3 areas in EPSG:32630. The parts cover 942380 m² between them and 701663 m² once combined. 240717 m² was covered more than once. Combining answers whether anywhere is covered, not how well. Two areas overlapping meant two things reached the same ground, and that is now gone. What distinguished the parts — which facility, which site — is discarded. That is the operation, not a defect.

note: Project every part to the declared CRS, union them, and compare the combined area, the piece count, and the summed area of the parts net of holes.

integrity.note: SHA-256 of this fixture with the integrity field removed, serialised with object keys sorted, no whitespace and UTF-8. Not the file's bytes: the lab reads fixtures through a transport that re-serialises JSON.
